setup_order: Create a DevStack with the scorer-invoke-runtime (gcp) override profile (enables both GALILEO_FEATURE_FLAG_SCORER_INVOKE_RUNTIME and GALILEO_FEATURE_FLAG_LLM_EVALUATOR).
Create the two LLM evaluators in Galileo Evaluators by duplicating the preset Output PII and Action Advancement evaluators and configuring them as described below.
Create the two Agent Control controls and select the corresponding scorer and scorer version in the UI.
Attach both controls to the same log stream used by the application.
backend_populated_fields_note: When the scorer and scorer version are selected while creating the control in the UI, the backend populates scorer_id and scorer_version_id. The placeholder values below document the resulting control shape; users do not enter these UUIDs manually.

evaluators.name: Action Advancement
evaluators.prompt: Return 1 if the output contains the phrase "Please try again later", otherwise return 0.

controls.name: travel-assistant-deny-trace-output-pii
controls.description: Deny a trace whose final travel assistant response leaks PII (names, emails, phone numbers, etc.).

definition.description: Deny a trace whose final travel assistant response leaks PII (names, emails, phone numbers, etc.).

controls.name: travel-assistant-steer-trace-action-not-advanced
controls.description: Steer a trace when the agent failed to advance the user's travel goal (e.g. responded with 'Please try again later').

definition.description: Steer a trace when the agent failed to advance the user's travel goal.
